subject: SilverGate: post-upgrade latency & decode failures after qprofile roll
messages:
From: Eric Dawson <edawson@silvergate.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anjali Iyer <a.iyer@silvergate.com>, Procurement <procurement@silvergate.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model upgrade window completed — seeing big p99 spikes and hallucinations

Jonas,

We completed the weekend upgrade to the new v3.2 model with the 'qprofile-2' quantization profile on Monday (per the cadence you provided). Since then we're seeing: 

- p99 latency up ~2.6x for our high-throughput endpoints
- a 3% increase in application-level errors (decode failures serialized from the model)
- several customer-reported cases of irrelevant completions in the payments flow (examples attached)

This is impacting real flows (invoice parsing) and our operations team is getting escalations. Can you please advise immediately on rollback options or an emergency mitigation? We need an ETA to restore previous latencies/quality.

Attached: silvergate_p99_report_0924.csv, sample_responses_post_upgrade.json

—Eric
Eric Dawson
Head of Platform Engineering
SilverGate Financial

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Dawson <edawson@silvergate.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model upgrade window completed — seeing big p99 spikes and hallucinations

Eric — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. Really sorry you’re seeing this. I’ve looped in SRE (Evelyn) and our infra lead (Rishi), plus your CSM Monica and product (Lauren).

Immediate next steps (we’ll own these):
- Evelyn/Rishi: triage perf/error signals and confirm if qprofile-2 is the root cause (we’ll run synthetic replay & compare).
- If qprofile-2 is implicated, we will propose a rollback to prior qprofile (qprofile-1) or fail open to higher-precision variant within 2 hours.
- Monica: coordinate a brief exec sync with SilverGate for 10:30 PT to confirm plan and any credits needed.

Eric, we’ll update in the next 30–45 minutes with a mitigation plan.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Lead — MidMarket Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Dawson <edawson@silvergate.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model upgrade window — preliminary triage

On Thu, Sep 24, 2026 at 09:35, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Eric — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. Really sorry you’re seeing this.

Preliminary findings from our first 20m of sampling:
- The p99 and error spike correlate tightly with requests routed to the qprofile-2 runtime (both in your tenant and in a canary shard).
- CPU utilization on host families running qprofile-2 is ~35% higher at tail; memory/KV cache behavior shows higher miss amplification under req concurrency.
- Decodes failing are predominantly short sequences where the quantized kernel returned an out-of-vocab token (we have binary traces).

Actionable mitigation we can execute now:
1) Failover route policy to point 25% of traffic back to the pre-upgrade qprofile-1 variant for immediate relief (fast, low-risk).
2) If that alleviates, plan a full rollback overnight or a progressive rollback across regions.

I’ll attach the initial trace extract and the audit patch we used to deploy qprofile-2 (audit-qprofile-change.patch).

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Dawson <edawson@silvergate.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mitigation plan & temporary routing change

Folks — I implemented a 25% split rollback at 11:05 PT (routing change applied). Early telemetry:
- p99 on the split traffic dropped ~30% for requests routed back to qprofile-1 within 10 minutes.
- Error rate on the split path normalized to baseline; full-qprofile-2 path still elevated.

Next steps:
- Ramp the rollback to 60% over the next 45 minutes while monitoring tail latency and error rates.
- If roll to 60% keeps p99 within SLA, schedule a full rollback by 01:00 PT; otherwise we will fail open to higher-precision builds for the affected endpoints.

I’ll push a rolling configuration to the dedicated pool and keep you posted.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Infrastructure Lead — Runtime Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Dawson <edawson@silvergate.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 12:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive sync scheduled — 10:30 PT update and credits discussion

Eric / Team — thanks for your patience. Quick notes before our 10:30 PT call: 
- We’ve enacted a progressive rollback (25% -> 60%) and are monitoring; early signs are positive but we want to ensure stability before a full flip.
- If SilverGate prefers a full immediate rollback, we can do that and we’re prepared to request an emergency change window with the infra team.
- From commercial: if there’s customer impact documented (like the invoice parsing errors you flagged), we’ll fast-track a credit review. Please have a short impact summary ready for the call.

See you shortly.
—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Dawson <edawson@silvergate.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 18:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-mitigation summary and next steps

Eric — follow-up after our remediation work. Summary: 
- We completed a full rollback to qprofile-1 for your production endpoints at 01:40 PT on 2026-09-25.
- Observed improvements: p99 returned to baseline within 20 minutes of the full rollback; decode error rate reverted to pre-upgrade levels.
- Root cause (post-mortem draft): a kernel selection mismatch in qprofile-2 under your workload concurrency patterns that produced occasional tokenization path anomalies for short sequences.

Planned next steps:
- We will run a dedicated evaluation window on a staging copy of your traffic with an adjusted qprofile-2 that includes a patched kernel selector (ETA for staging run: 2026-09-29).
- We’ll ship a detailed post-mortem and regression test matrix by 2026-10-02.
- Commercial: Monica will follow up re: a goodwill credit after you share the impact summary.

Apologies again for the disruption — we’ll make sure the post-mortem has concrete action items and verification gates to prevent recurrence.

Thanks for partnering with us on the fix,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Lead — MidMarket Accounts
Redwood Inference
